propositions: The review-bot container has no AWS region configured, causing boto3 client construction to fail with NoRegionError
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, falling through to boto3 ambient resolution which finds no region
boto3 resolves region from AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (not AWS_REGION) and environment configuration, but IMDS reachability does not supply region discovery
pydantic-ai re-raises boto3's NoRegionError as UserError, which is not caught by rebar's LLMError handlers, breaking the fail-closed review path
Pre-flight validation of boto3.session.Session().region_name must be added to raise typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION before client construction
AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION must both be explicitly set in the container environment for region resolution and rebar's provider_provenance tracking
